items.stem: The board asks for 'a clearer picture of performance.' What is the right first step before using Claude?

options.text: Agree a defined metric brief with the board's decision in mind
options.rationale: Correct: the question and decision must be defined before any drafting.

options.text: Ask Claude to generate a standard board template
options.rationale: A generic template does not answer this board's specific question.
Starting in the deck skips defining what is being measured.

options.text: Export every table from the ERP for completeness
options.rationale: Dumping all data does not clarify the decision the board faces.

items.stem: A reconciliation total in the model does not tie to the source extract. What should you do first?

options.text: Investigate the break before publishing any figure
options.rationale: Correct: a tie-out break signals a data or logic error to resolve first.

options.text: Publish the model number because it is more detailed
options.rationale: More detail does not make an untied number correct.

options.text: Average the model and source totals
options.rationale: Averaging hides rather than resolves the discrepancy.

options.text: Remove the reconciliation to clean up the sheet
options.rationale: Deleting the check destroys the signal that found the problem.
